title: Rationale and Cost of Developing AI Models for Healthcare Diagnostics, and Safeguards for Patient Data
what_it_is: Rationale and Cost of Developing AI Models for Healthcare Diagnostics, and Safeguards for Patient Data

sections.label: SIMFONI AI clinical decision support
sections.summary: SIMFONI develops AI tools for clinical decision support in managing chronic conditions, prioritising high disease burden and feasibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The Singapore Medical Foundation AI Model (SIMFONI) develops artificial intelligence (AI) tools to provide clinical decision support for managing chronic conditions, prioritising conditions with high disease burden in Singapore and feasibility of development.

sections.label: SIMFONI model adaptation and safeguards
sections.summary: SIMFONI models are adapted from international models using de-identified local data, with an independent unit testing them before deployment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: SIMFONI's models are built on existing models trained using international data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: They are adapted using local patient data, they are de-identified, in a secure national platform with well-established processes, expertise and safeguards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: To further ensure the integrity of this process, an independent safety and evaluation unit will carry out rigorous testing of SIMFONI's models before actual deployment.

sections.label: Careful use-case approach in healthcare
sections.summary: Healthcare is not simple, especially a public essential service, so a careful use-case approach is needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Because those of us who work in healthcare, you know it is not simple, especially a public essential service.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We have to take a very careful use-case approach.

sections.label: Distrust and scoping down data
sections.summary: Distrusting the system, scoping down data and requiring everyone's consent before use would make it a non-starter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If we start off thinking that we distrust this system entirely and therefore, let us scope down the data to be used to train models – even though we know the data is essential to train models that can improve healthcare, save lives, operate everything better and maybe help us address some of our very stark challenges of an ageing population with rising patient load – and if we accept that, but yet at the same time distrust the system and say, "Let's scope down the data, let's not believe that they can really be anonymised and de-dentified because there can be leaks and traceability", and "Let's seek everyone's consent before we can use", then it is a non-starter.

sections.label: TRUST data use and safeguards balance
sections.summary: TRUST data has been used incident-free, anonymised and de-identified by international standards, balancing technology use with safeguards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: And we started this process some years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: So, TRUST data has been used in various contexts already – so far, incident-free.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I think we make sure it is anonymised and de-identified by international standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I think let us proceed on that basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But we must strike a balance between leveraging that technology, but putting in place the safeguards.
